title: Be responsible for
subtitle: 負責、主管、處理、監督、承擔問責——究竟是哪一種 be responsible for？
description: 負責、主管、處理、監督、承擔問責——究竟是哪一種 be responsible for？

words.note: 和 be responsible for 最接近的日常替代表達之一。強調某人對一項工作、部門、人員或活動具有主要管理責任或控制權。

exercises.original: Daniel is responsible for the evening shift.
exercises.zh: Daniel 負責晚班。
exercises.upgrade: is in charge of · 負責；主管；掌管

options.explanation: — is in charge of = 負責、主管。表示 Daniel 是晚班的主要負責人。
— is familiar with = 熟悉，表示知道或了解，不表示負責。
— is interested in = 對……有興趣。

exercises.original: She is responsible for the entire marketing department.
exercises.zh: 她負責整個市場推廣部門。
exercises.upgrade: is in charge of · 負責；主管；掌管

options.explanation: — is in charge of 很自然地表示主管整個部門。

exercises.original: Who is responsible for organising the conference?
exercises.zh: 誰負責籌辦這個會議？
exercises.upgrade: is in charge of · 負責；主管；掌管

options.explanation: — is in charge of 直接詢問誰是主要負責人。
— is free from = 沒有／不受……影響。

words.note: 較正式，強調需要對結果、決定、資源或行為作出交代，尤其適合管理、法律、治理和專業語境。

exercises.original: Department heads are responsible for how public funds are spent.
exercises.zh: 部門主管須為公帑如何使用作出交代。
exercises.upgrade: are accountable for · 對……負責；須為……承擔責任

options.explanation: — are accountable for 強調須為資金使用作出交代。
— are interested in = 對……有興趣。
— are proud of = 為……感到自豪。

exercises.original: The director is responsible for the final outcome of the project.
exercises.zh: 總監須為項目的最終結果負責。
exercises.upgrade: is accountable for · 對……負責；須為……承擔責任

options.explanation: — is accountable for 最準確表達對最終結果承擔責任。

exercises.original: Officials must be responsible for any misuse of the data.
exercises.zh: 官員必須為任何濫用數據的行為承擔責任。
exercises.upgrade: be accountable for · 對……負責；須為……承擔責任

options.explanation: — be accountable for 表示需要承擔責任並接受追究。
— be involved in = 參與，未必表示負責。

words.note: 表示從較高層面監督一項工作、團隊、程序或項目。和 be responsible for 很接近，但更強調監察、統籌和確保工作正常進行。

exercises.original: He is responsible for the construction project from beginning to end.
exercises.zh: 他負責由始至終監督這個建築項目。
exercises.upgrade: oversees · 監督；統籌；負責監管

options.explanation: — oversees = 監督、統籌，適合大型項目管理。

exercises.original: The committee is responsible for implementing the new policy.
exercises.zh: 委員會負責監督新政策的實施。
exercises.upgrade: oversees · 監督；統籌；負責監管

options.explanation: — oversees 表示監督政策實施過程。

exercises.original: A senior editor is responsible for the publication process.
exercises.zh: 一名高級編輯負責監督出版流程。
exercises.upgrade: oversees · 監督；統籌；負責監管

options.explanation: — oversees 很自然地表示高級編輯監管整個流程。

words.note: 表示負責日常運作、人員、資源或工作流程。和 be responsible for 在工作分工語境中高度接近。

exercises.original: Sara is responsible for a team of twelve designers.
exercises.zh: Sara 負責管理一支由十二名設計師組成的團隊。
exercises.upgrade: manages · 管理；負責處理

options.explanation: — manages = 管理，表示她負責團隊的日常運作。

exercises.original: He is responsible for the department's annual budget.
exercises.zh: 他負責管理部門的年度預算。
exercises.upgrade: manages · 管理；負責處理

options.explanation: — manages 可表示負責預算分配和控制。

exercises.original: The operations manager is responsible for several regional offices.
exercises.zh: 營運經理負責管理幾個地區辦事處。
exercises.upgrade: manages · 管理；負責處理

options.explanation: — manages 直接表示日常管理多個辦事處。

words.note: 較日常，表示某人負責處理某類任務、問題、查詢、文件或情況。比 manage 更偏具體事項。

exercises.original: The reception team is responsible for all visitor enquiries.
exercises.zh: 接待團隊負責處理所有訪客查詢。
exercises.upgrade: handles · 負責處理；應付

options.explanation: — handles = 處理，最適合 enquiries 這類具體事項。

exercises.original: She is responsible for difficult customer complaints.
exercises.zh: 她負責處理棘手的客戶投訴。
exercises.upgrade: handles · 負責處理；應付

options.explanation: — handles complaints 是非常自然的搭配。

exercises.original: The legal team is responsible for contract disputes.
exercises.zh: 法律團隊負責處理合約爭議。
exercises.upgrade: handles · 負責處理；應付

options.explanation: — handles 表示負責處理具體法律事務。

words.note: 常見口語表達，可表示負責照顧人，也可表示處理某項工作、安排或問題。語氣比 be responsible for 輕鬆自然。

exercises.original: I'll be responsible for the travel arrangements.
exercises.zh: 旅行安排由我負責處理。
exercises.upgrade: take care of · 負責照料／處理；搞定

options.explanation: — take care of 很自然地表示『這件事我來處理』。
— catch up with = 追上／敘舊。

exercises.original: Can you be responsible for the invoices this afternoon?
exercises.zh: 你今天下午可以負責處理發票嗎？
exercises.upgrade: take care of · 負責照料／處理；搞定

options.explanation: — take care of 表示接手並處理發票工作。
— get rid of = 丟掉／消除。
— run into = 偶遇／遇到問題。

exercises.original: She is responsible for the children while their parents are away.
exercises.zh: 父母不在時，她負責照顧孩子。
exercises.upgrade: takes care of · 負責照料／處理；搞定

options.explanation: — takes care of 在照顧人的語境中尤其自然。

words.meaning: 被委派負責；被指派執行
words.note: 較正式，表示某人或團隊被明確指派一項任務或責任。重點在『任務是被交付的』。

exercises.original: The working group is responsible for reviewing the existing guidelines.
exercises.zh: 工作小組獲委派負責檢討現行指引。
exercises.upgrade: is tasked with · 被委派負責；被指派執行

options.explanation: — is tasked with reviewing 表示正式被委派這項任務。

exercises.original: A specialist team was responsible for investigating the incident.
exercises.zh: 一支專家團隊獲指派負責調查事故。
exercises.upgrade: was tasked with · 被委派負責；被指派執行

options.explanation: — was tasked with 強調調查工作是正式分派給該團隊。
— was interested in = 對……有興趣。
— was protected from = 受保護免受。

exercises.original: She has been made responsible for developing the new training programme.
exercises.zh: 她已獲委派負責制定新的培訓計劃。
exercises.upgrade: has been tasked with · 被委派負責；被指派執行

options.explanation: — has been tasked with 精確表示正式被委派工作。
— has been prevented from = 被阻止。
— has been interested in = 一直感興趣。
— has been worried about = 一直擔心。
— has been free from = 沒有受到。
— has been opposed to = 一直反對。

words.note: 和 be responsible for 幾乎是名詞化改寫。正式、中性，尤其適合職位說明、政策、組織架構和工作分工。
words.example: 這裡是否需要較正式地把 responsible 改寫成 responsibility 名詞結構？

exercises.original: The manager is responsible for staff training.
exercises.zh: 經理負責員工培訓。
exercises.upgrade: has responsibility for · 對……負有責任；負責

options.explanation: — has responsibility for 是 is responsible for 的直接名詞化改寫。
— has an interest in = 對……有興趣。
— has access to = 可接觸／使用。
— has doubts about = 對……有疑問。
— has contact with = 與……有聯絡。

exercises.original: The board is responsible for overall governance.
exercises.zh: 董事會對整體管治負有責任。
exercises.upgrade: has responsibility for · 對……負有責任；負責

options.explanation: — has responsibility for 正式而自然地表示組織責任。
— has difficulty with = 對……有困難。

exercises.original: Several departments are responsible for data security.
exercises.zh: 幾個部門共同負責數據安全。
exercises.upgrade: have responsibility for · 對……負有責任；負責

options.explanation: — have responsibility for 可表示共同承擔某項責任。
— have access to = 有權使用。
— have an interest in = 有興趣／利益關係。

words.note: 較正式，和 be accountable for 很接近，表示如果出現問題或結果，需要向上級、公眾或其他權力機構作出解釋。

exercises.original: Executives are responsible for serious failures in corporate governance.
exercises.zh: 高層管理人員須為企業管治的嚴重失誤作出交代。
exercises.upgrade: are answerable for · 須為……負責；須就……作交代

options.explanation: — are answerable for 強調需要就失誤向他人交代。

exercises.original: The minister is responsible for the actions of the department.
exercises.zh: 部長須為部門的行動負責並作交代。
exercises.upgrade: is answerable for · 須為……負責；須就……作交代

options.explanation: — is answerable for 適合政府／治理語境，表示政治或行政問責。

exercises.original: Managers should be responsible for decisions made under their authority.
exercises.zh: 管理人員應為其權限下作出的決定承擔責任。
exercises.upgrade: be answerable for · 須為……負責；須就……作交代

options.explanation: — be answerable for 表示決策者需要承擔問責責任。

words.meaning: 獲託付負責；受委託掌管
words.note: 表示某項重要工作、資產、資訊或責任因信任而交給某人負責。比 be responsible for 多了『被信任、受託』的語感。

exercises.original: She was responsible for protecting the confidential files.
exercises.zh: 她獲託付負責保護機密檔案。
exercises.upgrade: was entrusted with · 獲託付負責；受委託掌管

options.explanation: — was entrusted with 強調這項敏感責任因信任而交給她。

exercises.original: The treasurer is responsible for the charity's funds.
exercises.zh: 司庫受託負責管理慈善機構的資金。
exercises.upgrade: is entrusted with · 獲託付負責；受委託掌管

options.explanation: — is entrusted with 特別適合資金、財物和信託責任。

exercises.original: The senior nurse was responsible for caring for the vulnerable patient.
exercises.zh: 高級護士獲託付負責照顧這名脆弱病人。
exercises.upgrade: was entrusted with · 獲託付負責；受委託掌管

options.explanation: — was entrusted with 表示因專業信任而被交付照護責任。

words.note: 較口語，尤其用於照顧人、動物、場所、設備或日常事務。在這些語境可自然替代 be responsible for。

exercises.original: He is responsible for his elderly father at weekends.
exercises.zh: 週末他負責照顧年邁的父親。
exercises.upgrade: looks after · 照顧；照料；負責照看

options.explanation: — looks after = 照顧，最自然地表達照料家人。
— looks over = 快速查看／檢查。

exercises.original: Who is responsible for the office plants while Maria is away?
exercises.zh: Maria 不在時，誰負責照料辦公室植物？
exercises.upgrade: looks after · 照顧；照料；負責照看

options.explanation: — looks after 適合日常照料植物、動物、地方等。

exercises.original: The caretaker is responsible for the building when the office is closed.
exercises.zh: 辦公室關閉後由管理員負責照看大樓。
exercises.upgrade: looks after · 照顧；照料；負責照看

options.explanation: — looks after 表示照看、看管大樓。

falseSynonyms.zh: 參與不等於負責 be involved in 只表示參與某事；參與者未必承擔主要責任。
falseSynonyms.point: She is involved in the project, but David is responsible for it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 有關聯不等於負責 associated with 表示有關係或聯繫，不代表工作職責。
falseSynonyms.point: The brand is associated with luxury.

falseSynonyms.zh: 造成不等於職責上的負責 be responsible for 也可有『導致』義，但這是另一個 sense；在職務語境不能直接用 cause。
法律責任比一般 responsible 更窄 liable for 多指法律／財務上的責任或賠償義務，不是一般工作分工。
falseSynonyms.point: The company may be liable for the damage.

falseSynonyms.zh: 獲授權不等於負責 authorised to 表示有權做某事；有權不代表必須負責。
falseSynonyms.point: She is authorised to sign the contract.

falseSynonyms.zh: 被分派到某處不等於負責某事 assigned to 可表示被分派到一個部門、地點或案件，但不一定是主要負責人。
falseSynonyms.point: He was assigned to the London office.

falseSynonyms.zh: 監督只是 responsibility 的一種 supervise 很接近某些管理責任，但如果責任是親自處理、承擔結果或照顧，未必適合。
商業用語中的 ownership 不等於一般 responsible 工作場合有時說 own a task/process 表示全權負責，但屬較新的商業用語，不能在所有語境自然替換。
